author: Good Enough
description:
CoRoT-7 b is one of the most extreme rocky exoplanets ever discovered. It orbits so close to its star that temperatures on the dayside can become hot enough to melt rock, creating a brutal world that may be covered in oceans of molten lava.

With one side constantly blasted by intense stellar heat and the other locked in darkness, CoRoT-7 b is nothing like Earth. This Short explores what makes this planet so terrifying, how extreme its surface conditions may be, and what would happen to a human trying to survive there.

This video covers CoRoT-7 b, lava planets, extreme exoplanets, molten rock, alien worlds, and some of the harshest planetary conditions ever discovered.
